title: Disappearance of Malaysia Airlines flight MH370
place_text: Kuala Lumpur / South China Sea / Indian Ocean

tellings.quote: On March 8th, 2014, Malaysia Airlines flight MH370 took off from Koala Lumpur with 239 people aboard.

plain: On March 8, 2014, Malaysia Airlines flight MH370 took off from Kuala Lumpur with 239 people aboard and vanished. Michels tells this himself, in an episode about American scientists who have gone missing, where he brings the lost plane into that wider story of disappearances.
